main_sample_set: Same accepted unique acoustic shots from stationary_spectra; intersection of valid GNSS solutions
metric: Own arithmetic mean, population denominator N; no detrending or position smoothing
frame: Child CAD body origin in each acquisition's original true ENU frame
aggregate: Equal weight per 60-second window; intentional hand shaking excluded
interpretation: Conditional repeatability, not ground-truth accuracy; GNSS and relative position covariance retained
